description: Pause, resume or run a Pulse check. A paused check watches nothing and sends no alerts, which suits planned maintenance: resume it afterwards. "run" tests it now from each of its locations, outside the schedule and free; read the outcome with edge_get_pulse_check view "results".

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

name: edge_pulse_check_action
